`sample.json` is a DeckCheck `GET /api/external/deck` answer in the DOCUMENTED shape
(https://deckcheck.co/docs/api, read 2026-10-17), hand-built for the pilot's own
`ldeck` fixture list — not a redistribution of anyone's deck. `fullAnalysis` is null on
purpose: the bench never stores that HTML. Replace it with a recorded answer for one of
the pilot's public decks once Phase 0 of the DeckCheck plan has verified the live form.
